title: Add ability to connect to an already running gopls LSP
design: In internal/lsp/client.go, it always assumes I want to start a new MCP server when I start a new client. However, I already have a custom gopls server running on localhost:6060 that I want to connect to. I want you to alter the Client struct topoptionally run in a headless mode, where it does not execute a server process and it does not try to read the stderr from the server. Instead, it should just connect to the already running MCP server and otherwise handle everything like registering tools, sending and receiving messages, etc.
acceptance_criteria: For this task, do not worry about how to discover the running LSP server, just assume its running on localhost:6060. The task is complete when the MCP server runs and successfully connects to an already running LSP server, and the MCP tool calls succeed. Please also add tests as needed.
